messages.subject: For President Zou Jiayi | Sustainable infrastructure, government partnerships and emerging markets
messages.body:
Dear Ms. He,

Please place this executive introduction before President Zou Jiayi.

AIIB's sustainable-infrastructure mandate depends on trusted relationships with governments, strong stakeholder governance and disciplined translation of policy objectives into project execution. Those priorities align closely with my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional responses across complex regulated operating environments.

I would welcome a discussion about where this combination of government partnerships, sustainability and emerging-market execution might support AIIB's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
